veranderings.voor: Dit gaar groot hoeveelhede water op en stoor dit sodat
veranderings.na: Dit gaar groot hoeveelhede water op sodat
veranderings.rede: 'Opgaar' and 'stoor' say the same thing twice; keeping 'gaar op' preserves the link to the word opgaardam and saves three words.
'Vanself' is the idiomatic word for flowing without help; 'self' reads as 'the water itself' and the lesson already uses 'vanself' in the same sense later.

veranderings.voor: moet die water ver loop of teen 'n opdraande op
veranderings.na: moet die water ver of opdraand loop
veranderings.rede: The second half 'of teen 'n opdraande op' has no verb of its own and reads as an unfinished sentence; this version is complete, shorter and echoes 'afdraand' in Stop 3.

veranderings.voor: kan op pad van die dam na die aanleg staan of op pad na 'n reservoir
veranderings.na: kan op pad van die dam na die aanleg of op pad na 'n reservoir staan
veranderings.rede: With the verb at the end both places belong clearly to 'staan', instead of the second place trailing after the verb.
'Laastens' is the adverb for the final step in a sequence, and Stop 4 already uses it.
